assignments.essential_function: Build investor and board update decks with metrics,risks,forecasts and specific asks.

review: Selected unchanged for venture-backed company board/investor reporting:11section pack,owned inputs,metrics with targets,financials,cash/runway,risks,forecasts and concrete asks; monthly and fundraising variants included. Explicitly uses placeholders rather than invented numbers. All bundled references/template reviewed; ARR waterfall and NRR example reconcile. Benchmarks and narrative advice are prescriptive SaaS guidance,not universal standards.603 displayed installs is meaningful niche adoption but much smaller than official Anthropic candidates; repository stars and c-level issue report are broader signals,not proof of this skill outcome quality. No source rewrite or corrective wrapper proposed.
native_prerequisites: Verified company metrics and section-owner inputs; stage and meeting cadence.
Best fit is venture-backed SaaS boards; supplied company context chooses relevant metrics as upstream permits.
Deck content/template generation works directly; native slide rendering is a separate tool capability,not a bundled licensed dependency.
